title: Layer 3 round 4 major security+QE convergent: the terminal cleaner enumerates a fixed code-point list and misses the rest of the class (WORD JOINER, invisible operators, tag block, interlinear, line/para separators) — fix by Unicode category, not enumeration

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 800878a5: is_terminal_unsafe now strips by Unicode General_Category — Control (Cc), Format (Cf), LineSeparator (Zl), ParagraphSeparator (Zp) — so the WHOLE class is covered and a future Unicode format code point needs no code change; the enumeration whack-a-mole ends. Combining marks (Mn/Mc/Me) and normal spaces (Zs) are deliberately preserved (legitimate text, not the threat). Added unicode-general-category (pure-data lookup, no unsafe on the query path) with a docs/dependencies/ justification per the estate gate — flagged as the fix's one new dependency. Unit tests walk the class member by member (word joiner, invisible operators, tag block, interlinear, soft hyphen, line/para separators all stripped; cafe-with-combining, precomposed, and Japanese survive). One shared helper, both crates, every surface.
